label: A massive mothership hovering over the Vatican
description: Seen 27 October 2025: a massive craft like the mothership in Independence Day hovering over the Vatican, which he says will move at the speed of sound rather than the speed of light and will frighten everybody. He identifies it as demonic. A named place and an unmistakable event.

label: The scorpion tail: England, Canada, Australia and New Zealand
description: A marked line he calls the scorpion tail, beginning with the one in England and running over Canada to Australia and New Zealand, with great persecution told to him for those places. Given 27 October 2025.

label: He can delay it but will not stop it altogether
description: Reported 28 October 2025 as the Lord saying he can delay it but will not stop it altogether, that he is buying them time. Recorded because it is the clearest statement in the corpus of why the dated claims cannot expire on his own terms: a missed date is always a delay rather than a miss.
aliases: delay it but he will not stop it

label: Named department stores burned and ransacked in riots
description: Burning cars and looting, with Nordstrom and Macy stores ransacked and burned, seen ahead of a Saturday he describes as adults having a tantrum over losing free benefits. Naming the retailers is what makes it checkable.

label: A long track ice storm from Kentucky into Alabama
description: Seen on a map in light pink shading to dark pink and dark purple, starting in the Kentucky area and running clear into Alabama. He widens the instruction to pray against ice storms in the most unlikely places rather than only up north, which removes the geography that made it checkable, so the Kentucky to Alabama track is the scoreable version.
